issue_context.title: input-gamepad=yes hangs mpv opening streams, recent regresion
issue_context.body:
### Important Information

shinchiro's Windows build
```ps
> mpv -V
mpv v0.38.0-52-ge5d683e1 Copyright © 2000-2024 mpv/MPlayer/mplayer2 projects
 built on Apr 19 2024 00:13:22
libplacebo version: v7.349.0 (v6.338.0-124-gd0eb997-dirty)
FFmpeg version: N-114864-gbb9e4ff35
FFmpeg library versions:
   libavutil       59.15.100
   libavcodec      61.5.103
   libavformat     61.3.100
   libswscale      8.2.100
   libavfilter     10.2.101
   libswresample   5.2.100
```
Windows 10 10.0.19045 Build 19045

- If known which version of mpv introduced the problem

Sometime recently as I update mpv every weekish. I've had `input-gamepad=yes` in my config set for many years now. It happened when I updated mpv today. 

I believe the last time I updated mpv was Monday but I cannot verify that as I do not log it anywhere. The best I have is that yt-dlp was updated on the 14th (by the mpv updater). So that bounds it between the timestamp on the yt-dlp executable, 2024-04-14 at 17:03 UTC-4, and when I updated it today.

- GPU model, driver and version

Nvidia 2060 Super, Driver version: 551.86

- Possible screenshot or video of visual glitches

Just hangs here
![image](https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/assets/18294397/cf3338bc-a2ee-484e-ad37-79c3de2111b4)

### Reproduction steps

1. Attempt to open any video with `--input-gamepad=yes`
2. Video stream fails to open. No errors are see at any verbosity level.

For example: ` mpv --no-config --input-gamepad=yes av://lavfi:testsrc` just hangs. But remove ` --input-gamepad=yes` and it plays.

I first noticed it when I updated mpv tonight to see if another issue I was looking into was fixed.

### Expected behavior

The video stream opens

### Actual behavior

Nothing happens

### Log file

I just let it sit for two minutes to see if anything extra happened while logging. I hit Ctrl+C to end it.

[output.txt](https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/files/15032610/output.txt)

### Sample files

Just use the lavfi test video. But anything works.

review_comments: Would it make sense to make a non locking variant of this function?

I don't think it makes too much sense. Such function would be implemented in sdl_gamepad.c but still needs to be accessible from input.c, which requires a non-locking function to be exported publicly.
